notes: v670 - the auto-pilot could stand aside indefinitely even with plenty of proven evidence available. If 'Buy from' was set to 'Best proven scan' and no SCAN was currently beating the market, the bot emptied its list before it ever looked at your report-card ladder - and the ladder is the part that selects on graded SIGNAL LINES, which is the evidence Today's picks is built on and the evidence the 1 August testing measured. The ladder ran twenty-five lines too late to matter. Now, when there is no proven scan but your ladder DOES have proven signals today, the bot follows those instead of standing aside, and the diary says so. This does not weaken anything: with the ladder off, or with no proven signals of its own, the bot still stands aside exactly as before, and every other gate - price band, score, green day, day-jump, combo and your position cap - applies unchanged. To use it, make sure 'Auto-follow my report-card ladder' is ticked in My Rules. Practice money only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
